# Pull Request Rules

## RetroVERSE 

- All original code submitted to RetroVERSE shall be licensed under GPL-3.0, in accordance with the main RetroDECK project license. Sourced third-party applications, tools, code, and software components remain subject to their respective original licenses.
- All third-party components, applications and data must have licenses compatible with redistribution or have permissions of the original creators.
- New submissions must be discussed with the RetroDECK Team prior to acceptance.
    - The RetroDECK Team retains final authority over all submissions and their acceptance into RetroVERSE.
- Applications submitted for inclusion must comply with RetroDECK's ethical and social guidelines. Any application that violates these guidelines will be rejected.
    - Applications involving scams, MLM recruitment, dubious cryptocurrency/NFT schemes, viruses, malware, or any other deceptive, harmful, dangerous, or compromising activities are strictly prohibited.
    - Applications or tools intended to distribute, request, or facilitate unauthorized access to copyrighted ROMs, BIOS files, game files, shader dumps, unauthorized game streaming services, taken-down projects, leaked games or related materials, or other copyrighted assets are strictly prohibited.
    
## General PR Rules

- The PR title needs to be clear and human-readable.
- The RetroDECK Team needs to understand your PR as well, so be prepared to explain in your own words why this PR is needed and what you hope to achieve. You may be asked about the full PR or just specific sections and you should be able to explain whichever comes up.
- **Most importantly:** You must understand every line of code you are submitting.

## LLM Rules

- Fully **automated PRs** submitted through external agents are **not allowed**.
-  We currently do not accept AI-co-authored pull requests. 
    - This restriction applies exclusively to original code you submit to RetroVERSE for integration into RetroDECK. It does not apply to externally sourced applications, components, data, or files, which remain eligible for submission regardless of whether they were developed partially or entirely with AI assistance.
- You may use an LLM as a light writing assistant to help draft and paste the explanation of outside of your PR in order to:
    - Overcome language barriers.
    - Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, sentence structure and capitalisation.
    - Communicate more effectively, for example, by helping with markdown formatting.
- If the RetroDECK Team has questions about your PR, you are **not allowed** to set up **automated responses** to those questions, as that would be considered rude and neither gentlemanly nor ladylike.
    - However, you may draft your response and refine it using the light writing assistant rules outlined above to help you convey your message clearly. We simply want to talk to **you** not to an AI or a bot. In other words, don't say: "Hey AI, reply to the RetroDECK Team for me plx." That would count as an automated response and not elegant.
